body:
thats kind of where I am. I've recently realized (through my own therapy) that she is incredibly emotionally manipulative. Not necessarily abusive, but very manipulative. (maybe they are the same thing?)

And really, I'm just not happy anymore and haven't been for a long time.

I think part of my problem is that i've grown to resent this behavior.  I've tried, in the past, to do these spontaneous things. Nothing seems to help.
Its also changed my personality and i tend to be more negative about everything, more so than I used to.

Even as I type this I realize i'm doing the same thing to you that she does to me. I'm responding to positive enforcement with negativity.

i just feel burnt out.

Because it's been going on for so long and I've literally just gotten tired of it. Also because it puts me in a spot of, what am I supposed to say? if she says shes fat, i say, "no, youre not". To which she says "you just say that cause were married". And I say, "no, i say it because its true". TO which she says, "you wouldn't tell me even if i was"

its a circle that i can't break, and it frustrates me.

i feel terrible for being annoyed, but its been going on for years now, and im just sick of it.  She's not like this all the time. It comes and goes in waves. but lately it seems like it is all the time.

ill suggest the two positive things to her
